name: Portfolio Constraint Engine
required_scope: Re-run Gate 3 eligibility and freshness immediately before every S13 calculation.
Calculate existing issuer, single-name, sector, country, correlated exposure, liquidity, holding-period, downside, risk-budget, opportunity-cost, and applicable hedge constraints.
Show every limit, current value, candidate value, formula, source field, missing item, escalation threshold, and binding status.
Return a null final maximum when any required constraint is missing.
Describe the calculated maximum only as a constraint ceiling, never a suggested, approved, target, or optimal position.
Keep System Portfolio Assessment NOT_EVALUATED, User Decision PENDING, approved range null, and automatic trading disabled until S14.
gate3_and_identity_controls: The runner loads and assesses Gate 3, reloads it immediately before calculation, and assesses it again.
A report ID, schema version, or contract-hash change between checks returns GATE_4_BLOCKED_GATE_3_CHANGED_DURING_RECHECK.
The constraint input report ID and hash must match both the freshness attestation and consumed Gate 3 contract.
Candidate SEC CIK must match the Gate 3 company CIK; an equity candidate ticker must also match.
Stale or ineligible Gate 3 suppresses every private constraint, return, risk, sizing, and action calculation.

constraint_formulas.concentration: max(0, policy limit - current matching gross-long weight)
constraint_formulas.liquidity_exit_capacity: ADVT * maximum daily volume participation * maximum days to exit / portfolio NAV
constraint_formulas.risk_budget: max(0, risk budget limit - current downside-loss budget usage) / abs(validated candidate downside return)
constraint_formulas.opportunity_cost: candidate validated return - highest comparable validated alternative return >= minimum excess return
constraint_formulas.final_incremental_ceiling: minimum of every required numeric constraint ceiling
constraint_formulas.final_total_issuer_ceiling: current issuer gross-long weight + final incremental ceiling

data_and_accounting_controls: Exposure-only dimension rows must explicitly use GROSS_LONG_WEIGHT; absence is MISSING rather than zero.
Only complete aggregated or full holdings may support a derived zero existing exposure.
Exposure dimensions overlap and are never summed across issuer, sector, country, or correlation buckets.
ADVT must be dated, reviewed, in portfolio base currency, and within the explicit policy age limit.
Expected return and downside must use the same reproducible as-of date, target date, and holding period.
Public price sensitivity is prohibited as an expected-return or downside-return input.
A public probability-weighted return is accepted only when the Gate 3 formal output validates and exactly reconciles.
A public formal Bear return requires a validated formal scenario-return object; otherwise downside remains missing.
Current risk-budget usage must use the same DOWNSIDE_LOSS_BUDGET method as policy.
Missing and provisional values never receive hidden defaults.
hedge_boundary: A proposed hedge is checked against permitted instruments, maximum ratio, effectiveness status, and reviewer chronology.
A required invalid hedge creates a zero ceiling.
S13 never increases the unhedged ceiling for assumed hedge relief.
privacy_boundary: Real constraint inputs and results remain in a repo-external local workspace.
The initializer creates portfolio_constraint_inputs.yaml with mode 0600 and no policy defaults.
Git ignore and pre-commit scanning block exact private input and result filenames.
The local terminal prints no private values and no calculated ceiling.
The complete result is written atomically with mode 0600.
Local S13 modules import no network, telemetry, crash-reporting, or logging clients.

synthetic_acceptance.interpretation: Synthetic values verify contract behavior only and are not portfolio facts, a suggested position, approval, or investment action.

scope_boundary: S13 does not issue Eligible, Eligible with Escalation, Review Required, Not Eligible, or Not Evaluated assessments; those belong to S14.
S13 does not create a recommended or approved position range.
S13 does not convert escalation thresholds into a User decision.
S13 does not generate the S14 bilingual One-Page, Full Report, Evidence Appendix, or Validation Report.

exact_next_starting_point.name: Gate 4 Assessment, Approval and Reports
exact_next_starting_point.first_action: Consume the validated S13 output contract and define the separate System Assessment and User Decision state machines before adding bilingual synthetic reports.
